# VB-CABLE (external, separately licensed)

For a system microphone, install the official [VB-CABLE](https://vb-audio.com/Cable/) separately, select **CABLE Input** in LinkMic, and **CABLE Output** in your recording/conference app.

VB-CABLE is proprietary donationware by VB-Audio / Vincent Burel. It is **not MIT-licensed** and no driver binary is tracked in this source repository. The Windows release archive may include the vendor's original, unmodified ZIP and original readme, distributed separately from LinkMic's installation. [Donations and license purchases](https://shop.vb-audio.com/) support its author. Follow the [vendor licensing terms](https://vb-audio.com/Services/licensing.htm).

`provenance.json` identifies the original Pack45 archive used for the existing release. Building LinkMic itself does not require the driver.
